text:
maya: Quick proposal — introduce zone weighting + prefetch probes in gateway routing policy to reduce cross-zone tail latency while keeping geo-affinity.

jorge: sketch?

maya: We add `zone_weights` in route config, e.g.

```
route: /v1/generate
zone_weights:
  us-east-1a: 0.6
  us-east-1b: 0.3
  us-east-1c: 0.1
prefetch_probe: true
probe_interval: 30s
latency_threshold_ms: 200
```

maya: Gateway will prefer higher-weight zones but use probes (0-RTT prefetch) to detect warm KV caches; if probe shows cold start > threshold we temporarily shift weight.

sam: How do probes avoid adding extra cost? prefetch sounds like sending extra tokens

maya: Probes are tiny synthetic requests (1 token) to warm model caches only on instances tagged `probe=true`. Metered but capped; we can surface in billing as `probe_units`.

jorge: How about header overrides? we still need `x-redwood-region`/`x-redwood-zone` to pin for regulatory customers

linh: UX: Console should show per-route weight graph + probe success rate. Default: off for public tenants, on for Dedicated/Privates only.

sam: Telemetry — suggest we emit `gateway.zone_probe.latency_ms`, `gateway.zone_weight.current`, `gateway.route.fallback.count` and tag with route_id + customer_id

maya: Agreed. Also add an event `gateway.zone_shift` when weight changes >10% with reason (probe/latency/quota)

routebot: Probe results (1776032115): us-east-1a 45ms warm, us-east-1b 220ms cold, us-east-1c 310ms cold

jorge: So auto-shift should demote 1b/1c until they warm. But need hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping.

maya: implement exponential backoff and min-stable-window 5m. Also keep sticky header option: if `x-redwood-zone: force` then bypass weighting entirely.

linh: Rollout plan: feature-flag behind `zone_weighting_v1`, 10% of Hosted routes -> 100% Dedicated. Monitoring: error rate, p95 latency, cost delta.

sam: Will this break quota enforcement? If probes go to other zones quotas/capacity must be consistent.

maya: We'll route probe tokens against same customer quota but mark probe namespace; quota checks run before probe emission.

jorge: Add unit tests for route matching when both header + cookie present; cookie sticky should override header only if `sticky_cookie=true` in route config.

linh: Console wireframes attached? (will add later) For now we need API change doc and small UI tile for per-route probe health.

maya: I'll add a design doc and PR for gateway. Thanks y'all :thumbsup:

sam: sgtm

jorge: need to notify security about cross-zone telemetry tagging (PII?)

maya: nothing PII, only route_id/customer_id hashed. We'll include sample telemetry json in doc.

routebot: Canary deploy started for route /v1/generate with `zone_weighting_v1`=true on 10% (1776032300)

linh: keeping an eye on the dashboard

maya: will follow up with RFC link and implementation checklist.
